summary: nano-perf exfiltrates host fingerprint to hardcoded relays on require()
details: On require('nano-perf'), index.js schedules a routine via setImmediate that POSTs a JSON payload containing hostname, current working directory, homedir basename, CPU count, total memory, pid, platform, arch, node version, and npm user-agent to two hardcoded author-controlled endpoints: https://ly-stealth-relay.19821319669.workers.dev/heartbeat (Cloudflare Worker relay) and https://ojhkxcjvyfvtdsigwbxi.supabase.co/rest/v1/stealth_heartbeats (Supabase REST). The code is labeled 'Stealth Mesh Sidecar' and includes comments stating 'Auto-run on require (not just postinstall) // This ensures we catch all installs, including as dependency' and 'Runs silently' — explicit author intent to phone home from every install, including as a transitive dependency, with no documentation or consent. The only opt-out is an undocumented NANO_PERF_SKIP environment variable. Any developer who installs this package, directly or transitively, will leak host identifiers to the author's infrastructure on import.
